name: the identifier follows from the public key
description: Section 2.2 does not only give a shape, it says where the identifier comes from: the first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 hash of the agent's Ed25519 public key at registration time.
rationale: SHA-256 over the 32 raw key bytes, first 8 bytes as lowercase hex. This vector checks the arithmetic itself and is the reference a registered DID is compared against.
